still: A row of three-story brick shop buildings on a muddy 1850s street at dusk, the whole row lifted about one meter above the ground on hundreds of wooden blocks and iron screw jacks, shop windows glowing warm, the shopkeeper waving from an open door with a broom.
video: The row of buildings rises a tiny bit; lanterns sway; the shopkeeper keeps sweeping.

still: A young wooden-and-brick 1850s lakeside town seen from the water at dusk, the streets barely above the flat grey lake, small waves almost touching the boardwalks.
video: Gentle waves lap at the boardwalks; chimney smoke drifts.

still: A flooded muddy street in heavy rain, a horse-drawn cart stuck up to its axles, a wooden sign sticking out of the mud, puddles reflecting warm window light.
video: Rain falls; the cart wheel spins and sinks deeper.

still: Three serious city officials in top hats around a candle-lit table with a big map of the city; one of them points up at the ceiling with a wild grin.
video: The officials lean in; the candle flame flickers.

still: A cutaway view of a brick building standing on a tall stack of timber blocks, a giant measuring stick beside it showing the building lifted high above the old street level, workers below looking up.
video: The measuring stick marker slides upward.

still: Inside an elegant 1850s hotel room at night, the sleepy guest snoring in a big four-poster bed, a candle on the nightstand, through the window the street outside is clearly lower than it should be.
video: The guest snores; the view in the window slowly drops lower.

still: The young engineer stands in a busy 1850s street holding rolled-up plans, looking up at half a block of brick shops with a confident smile, crowds and carriages around him.
video: The engineer unrolls the plans; people walk past.

still: Under a brick building, hundreds of iron screw jacks in neat rows on timber pads, hundreds of workers in caps kneeling beside them with long iron bars, lit by many lanterns.
video: Lantern light flickers along the endless rows of jacks.

still: Close-up of the engineer blowing a brass whistle while a worker's hands turn the handle of an iron screw jack with a long bar.
video: The bar turns one small notch; the whistle moves to his lips.

still: Extreme close-up of an iron screw jack under a thick wooden beam, a ruler beside it showing a tiny gap opening between the beam and the old stone foundation.
video: The tiny gap grows a hair wider.

still: Inside a cosy 1850s general store lit by oil lamps, the shopkeeper smiling and handing a paper parcel to a customer, jars and shelves perfectly still, a calm cat on the counter.
video: The shopkeeper hands over the parcel; the cat's tail flicks.

still: A two-story wooden house sitting on round logs in the middle of a street, pulled by a team of horses, a surprised visitor in a tall hat and a Scottish tartan scarf watching from the boardwalk.
video: The house rolls forward slowly on the logs; the horses pull.

still: A long parade of several wooden houses on logs rolling down one street at sunset, one after another, the visitor in the tartan scarf counting on his fingers in the foreground.
video: The houses roll along in a line; the visitor counts.

still: A calm night view of a lakeside town with a fork in the road: one path leads up a ramp to a lifted street, the other path leads to green hills, empty space in the middle for two choice candles.
